content.title: Opening Day: Oilfield services provider Flowco jumps in market debut
content.summary: Shares of oilfield services provider Flowco jumped in their market debut on Thursday, as they opened for trading 21% above their IPO price. LATEST IPOS AND DIRECT LISTINGS: Flowco (FLOC) opened on January 16 at $29.00. The provider of production optimization, artificial lift and methane abatement solutions for the oil and natural gas industry had priced its initial public offering of 17.8M shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $24.00 per share.
